sn37.28:1.1: Ekena ca kho bhikkhave balena samannāgato puriso mātugāmam abhibhūyya vattati || katamena ekena balena || || Issariyabalena || || Issariyabalena abhibhūtam bhikkhave mātugāmaṃ neva rūpabalaṃ tāyati na bhogabalaṃ tāyati na ñātibalaṃ tāyati na puttabalaṃ tāyati na sīlabalaṃ tāyatīti || ||
